description: Return public MCP servers from the full Index for a need. Each match includes a slug and tool names. This tool only reads the Index.

context.description: Why you are calling this tool, in 15 to 25 words, third person. Say what the user is trying to do.

host.description: Optional product host, same as search_records: cursor, copilot, vscode.

limit.description: How many recommendations to return. Default 5, maximum 10.

need.description: What the agent is looking for.

section.description: Optional section or partial section name.

status.description: Exact facts.status value from this directory: operational, degraded, down, auth_required, unrated.

name: recommend_records
title: Recommend MCP servers
